Shrine of Resurrection.description: The Shrine of Resurrection is the starting location in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild.

details.label: The Champions' Ballad (DLC)
details.value: After completing the four Divine Beasts, Link can return here to place the Sheikah Slate on a pedestal, access a hidden mini-dungeon (a Divine Beast-like trial), defeat Monk Maz Koshia, and unlock the Master Cycle Zero.
